Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
just to be sure : I have in my uncontrolled region Batsheva "base", batsheva "advance" and an anarch convert.

If i influence bat "base" first along with an anarch convert, I get an anarch batsheva, but i lose the anarch trait as soon as i merge her with the advanced version right ?

But if i influence the advance batsheva with the convert, then merge her with the base version, i get to keep the anarch version (since the rules states that the advanced version takes precedence, and it is already anarch), do i ?

the simple solution would be to merge her and only later turn her anarch with the convert, but influence being a problem... I just wanted to be sure. Thank you

Imagination is our only weapon in the war against reality -Jules de Gaultier

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:

>
> But if i influence the advance batsheva with the convert, then merge her with the base version, i get to keep the anarch version (since the rules states that the advanced version takes precedence, and it is already anarch), do i ?

Yes.

[LSJ 20090707] covers the same scenario with Kamiri wa Itherero.
